name: query-negative-tests-39b4ca8ff2/query-empty-tuple-negative-e.bal
spec_references: Expressions: Query expressions — Supports `from`, `where`, `let`, `join` (including outer join), `order by`, `limit`, `on conflict` and `select` clauses
Subset restrictions / Import declarations: Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported; ballerina/lang.value lists cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString and toBalString

Subset restrictions / Invocations / Other invocation restrictions: Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions (includes value:toString; excludes clone and cloneReadOnly)
reason: The case asserts rejection of queries over empty tuples, including select expressions calling cloneReadOnly() and clone(), which are outside the supported langlib methods. It also includes a query action ending in do, absent from the supported query-expression clauses and statement/action lists. These essential unsupported constructs make the whole case a feature classification despite supported from/select negative checks elsewhere.
test_design_notes: The ordinary from/select empty-tuple rejection checks are negative type-system tests and are not excluded merely because their code is illegal.
toString() is explicitly supported; it is not the reason for this classification.
